description: Three decisions written as keywords, two of them on one call -- what the debug console executes, and who can reach it. Debug mode is not a matter of noisy output: Flask's debug server exposes a console that executes Python sent to it, so reaching production with it on is remote code execution. The second request passes a timeout and no verify keyword and is silent, because a keyword that is absent says nothing about what the default is.

expected.note: certificate verification disabled for this request
the Werkzeug console executes code sent to it
